items.q: And we had a piano player named Garnett Clark, fantastic little young piano player.

ctx.x: And we had a piano player named Garnett Clark, fantastic little young piano player. He went to Europe years ago. He died in Paris. He was a kind of wild guy. He played with Charlie Barnett for a while way back there then. You know, Charlie was integrated long before anybody else, you know. He went with Charlie -- he went with him way back there then.
